build.output:
'Delphi.Perturb.no_teleost_below' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'Delphi.Perturb.perturb_nonvacuous' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

witness.name: Delphi.Perturb.perturb_nonvacuous
witness.via: bundle Record has a field of type OsmolyteDepthCap, a hypothesis of Delphi.Perturb.no_teleost_below

joint.outcome: theorem from standard axioms with no shared-scope hypotheses: consistent with every satisfiable law set

law.statement_en: Under the osmolyte hypothesis (teleost internal osmolality rises linearly with depth via TMAO and cannot exceed seawater), no teleost lives deeper than the isosmotic depth, at most 8200 m.

hypotheses.name: see theorem statement
hypotheses.statement: the named hypothesis structure(s) in the theorem statement; instantiated with fetched numbers in Delphi.Perturb.measured

scope.basis: TMAO-depth relation in marine teleosts (Yancey et al. 2014); not for elasmobranchs or invertebrates

sources: Yancey PH, Gerringer ME, Drazen JC, Rowden AA, Jamieson A 2014, Marine fish may be biochemically constrained from inhabiting the deepest ocean depths. (PMID 24591588, doi:10.1073/pnas.1322003111); lean/perturb-sources.json#yancey2014
